script_text: Stop, Taurus, because one conversation today could derail relationships and career. Venus, the ruler of your fixed Earth sign, is in Scorpio, your 7th House, where Mars in Cancer squares it. The Sun in your 6th House opposes Uranus in your 3rd, destabilizing routines and communication. Saturn-Pluto's conjunction in Aquarius, your 10th House, concentrates authority and money. If you're single, attraction to a bold, articulate person who welcomes direct questions may feel competitive. If you're partnered, expect pressure around priorities and reliability; delay your answer because haste can turn clarity into conflict. In your 10th House, Saturn and Pluto demand contracts, written approvals, and a budget audit before any major purchase. Avoid texts, transfers, or resignations while Mars challenges Venus, because wounded pride will make each demand sound personal. Follow for tomorrow's reading, because this 7th-house tension keeps unfolding all week.
